title: COVID-19 Detection Using Photoplethysmography and Neural Networks
summary: A custom CNN classified PPG segments from 93 COVID-19 patients and 90 controls; patient-level holdout performance was 78% accuracy, 75% sensitivity and 81% specificity. This is a small retrospective screening result, not clinical utility evidence.
ai_technology: A custom convolutional neural network classifies raw PPG segments as COVID-19 or control after signal-quality filtering.
organization: Department of Information Engineering, University of Florence, 50139 Florence, Italy

evidence.tested: Held-out patient-level results report 78% accuracy, 75% sensitivity and 81% specificity (the segment metrics are separately reported).
evidence.unknown: The paper reports cross-validation and a held-out patient-level assessment on 32 patients; sample size and case-control design limit generalization.
evidence.ai_role: A custom convolutional neural network classifies raw PPG segments as COVID-19 or control after signal-quality filtering.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
